projects.title: Hotel Management System
projects.description: A comprehensive MERN stack application for hotel operations management with real-time booking, room management, and guest services.
projects.longDescription: Built a full-featured hotel management system that streamlines operations from booking to checkout. The system handles room inventory, guest management, billing, and reporting with a modern, intuitive interface.
features: Real-time room availability and booking system

projects.title: Bike/EV Subscription Platform
projects.description: A modern subscription-based platform for bike and electric vehicle rentals with flexible plans and seamless user experience.
projects.longDescription: Developed an innovative subscription platform that revolutionizes urban mobility. Users can subscribe to bikes or EVs with flexible monthly plans, track usage, manage payments, and locate nearby vehicles.
features: Real-time vehicle tracking with Google Maps

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.description: A robust Java-based library management system with efficient book cataloging, member management, and transaction tracking.
projects.longDescription: Created a comprehensive library management solution using Java and MySQL. The system handles book inventory, member registrations, issue/return tracking, fine calculation, and generates detailed reports for library administrators.

projects.title: Virtual Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered virtual assistant capable of voice commands, task automation, and intelligent responses using natural language processing.
projects.longDescription: Built an intelligent virtual assistant that understands natural language commands and performs various tasks. Features include voice recognition, web searches, application control, reminders, and conversational AI capabilities.
